notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
- Removed the crowbar slot (The crowbar is now a normal weapon)
-Added a pills slot (Pills now have their own slot instead of fighting with med kits)
-Fixed weapon spread not working if bullets did not hit a wall
-Reworked crowbar
- Changed some LOD models to look better

Now the game should be more fun. Thanks for playing and if you have feedback, you can leave it here in the comments or on the discussions page

Richard R.
